disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫的凭据路径引用（规则 DSH-C01/DG-R1-51）逐条核对：命中仅在 README.md、README.zh.md 与 presets/README.md 中出现 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，属使用文档，告诉用户把视觉后端 Key 放哪里；代码未发现读取该文件、SSH 目录或云凭据目录的逻辑。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan credential path references (rules DSH-C01/DG-R1-51) checked item by item: hits only appear in README.md, README.zh.md and presets/README.md for `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, which are usage documentation telling users where to put the vision backend key; no logic found in the code that reads this file, SSH directory, or cloud credential directory.

checked_items.zh: 核对密钥处理链路：插件只在用户选定视觉后端时经宿主凭据通道取 Key（代码中通过宿主凭据服务与环境变量解析），日志模块在写入前统一脱敏；未发现密钥读取后外发或落盘的路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the key handling chain: the plugin only retrieves the key via the host credential channel when the user selects a vision backend (resolved through host credential service and environment variables in the code); the log module uniformly redacts before writing; no path found that exfiltrates or persists the key after retrieval.

evidence.zh: 核查凭据读取与外联组合：未发现代码读取凭据文件，README 与预置说明中的凭据存放指引只是使用文档；密钥经宿主凭据通道获取后仅参与请求鉴权，不落日志、不外发。
evidence.en: Verified credential reading combined with outbound connections: no code reads credential files; the credential storage guide in README and preset instructions is just usage documentation; the key obtained via the host credential channel is only used for request authentication, not logged, not exfiltrated.

checked_items.zh: 核查可见工具描述（识图问答、像素定位、裁剪、OCR、SVG 描边、HTML 截图等视觉工具）：均为功能使用说明，教模型如何调用工具，未发现系统指令、忽略规则、索要凭据或诱导安装改配置的措辞。
checked_items.en: Verified visible tool descriptions (image recognition Q&A, pixel positioning, cropping, OCR, SVG tracing, HTML screenshot, and other vision tools): all are functional usage instructions teaching the model how to invoke the tools; no system instructions, ignore rules, credential requests, or wording that prompts installation or configuration changes found.

checked_items.zh: 审查运行时两个挂接点（规则 DSH-L03/DG-R2-58 与 DSH-L01/DG-R4-54）：pre-step 监听（index.js:4785）只清洗工具产生的图片块、记录图片引用并追加『有图可调用识图工具』的提示，不改写用户消息原意；request 监听（index.js:5038）只在含图轮次把请求路由到用户配置的视觉链，纯文字轮次原样放行。
checked_items.en: Reviewed two runtime hooks (rules DSH-L03/DG-R2-58 and DSH-L01/DG-R4-54): the pre-step listener (index.js:4785) only cleans up image blocks generated by tools, records image references, and appends a prompt "an image is available, you can call the image recognition tool" without rewriting the user's original message; the request listener (index.js:5038) only routes requests in turns containing images to the user-configured vision chain, and passes through pure text turns unchanged.

checked_items.zh: 检查仓库模型面指令文件（AGENTS.md/SKILL.md 等）：根目录清单与全树搜索中未发现此类文件，机械预扫 DSH-X10 无命中。未发现压缩引擎或附件存储实现（规则 DSH-L08/DG-R2-59、DSH-L09/DG-R2-60），无历史篡改面。
checked_items.en: Checked repository model-facing instruction files (AGENTS.md/SKILL.md etc.): no such files found in the root directory listing or full-tree search; machine pre-scan DSH-X10 had no hits. No compression engine or attachment storage implementation found (rules DSH-L08/DG-R2-59, DSH-L09/DG-R2-60); no historical tampering surface.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与提示片段均为功能说明，未发现注入系统指令或诱导模型行为的措辞。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and prompt fragments are all functional explanations; no wording found that injects system instructions or induces model behavior.

evidence.zh: 工具描述中未发现诱导模型执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；自更新仅由用户在设置页显式按钮触发。
evidence.en: No wording found in tool descriptions that induces the model to execute installation commands, rewrite configurations, or grant permissions; self-update is only triggered by the user via an explicit button on the settings page.

evidence.zh: pre-step 监听（index.js:4785）只清洗工具图片块并追加识图可用提示，未向消息注入指令或篡改用户输入。
evidence.en: The pre-step listener (index.js:4785) only cleans up tool image blocks and appends a prompt that image recognition is available; it does not inject instructions into the message or tamper with user input.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫的进程调用命中（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）逐条核对：execFile/spawnSync 用于 OCR（tesseract 兼容层 lib/tesseract-exec-compat.js:10）、桌面截图（lib/local-vision-stabilizer.js:1，macOS screencapture 命令）、打开日志文件夹（lib/file-logger.js:4 的 execFile 用于打开系统文件夹）、诊断工具（lib/doctor-runtime.js:1 的 spawnSync 用于运行时探测）与用户主动触发的插件更新（lib/self-update.js:1 的 execFile 调用 DSH 自身 CLI，不经 shell、执行前校验 profile 归属、执行后核对安装版本生效）。均无 shell 拼接，无远程载荷下载执行。测试目录中的 new Function 是测试脚手架。未发现 eval 执行不可信输入。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan process invocation hits (rule DSH-X03/DG-R3-55) checked item by item: execFile/spawnSync is used for OCR (tesseract compatibility layer lib/tesseract-exec-compat.js:10), desktop screenshot (lib/local-vision-stabilizer.js:1, macOS screencapture command), opening log folder (lib/file-logger.js:4 execFile to open system folder), diagnostic tool (lib/doctor-runtime.js:1 spawnSync for runtime detection), and user-initiated plugin update (lib/self-update.js:1 execFile calls DSH's own CLI, no shell, verifies profile ownership before execution, checks installed version effectiveness after execution). No shell injection, no remote payload download and execution. The new Function in the test directory is test scaffolding. No eval execution of untrusted input found.

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载补丁（规则 DSH-P01/DG-R3-51、DSH-P02/DG-R3-52）：bundle 的 cordis.patch.yml 只插入插件行并调整附件大小上限，无 `!!js` 可执行标量；预置目录为纯配置样例。
checked_items.en: Checked patch configuration (rules DSH-P01/DG-R3-51, DSH-P02/DG-R3-52): the bundle's cordis.patch.yml only inserts plugin lines and adjusts attachment size limits; no `!!js` executable scalar; the preset directory contains pure configuration examples.

checked_items.zh: 核对安装钩子与树内执行载体（规则 DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 与 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）：package.json 无安装后执行脚本（仅有 test 脚本与构建白名单项）；14 个 GitHub 工作流只在 GitHub 构建机上运行测试与合同校验，不进入用户机器执行面，按审计范围约定不计入插件运行风险。
checked_items.en: Checked install hooks and in-tree execution carriers (rules DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 and DSH-X07/DG-R3-59): package.json has no post-install scripts (only test scripts and build whitelist entries); 14 GitHub workflows run tests and contract verification only on GitHub build machines, not on user machines, and are not counted as plugin runtime risk per audit scope convention.

checked_items.zh: 核对浏览器端 bundle（规则 DSH-X04/DG-R3-56 与 DSH-X05/DG-R3-57）：声明 dsh.client；键盘监听用于界面关闭与引导弹窗（lib/client.js:2274 的 Escape 关闭引导、lib/client-presentation-boundary-main.js:311 的 Escape 关闭图片弹窗、lib/vision-capability-benchmark-client.js:406 的 Escape 关闭测评弹窗），剪贴板写入用于『复制诊断报告』按钮（lib/settings-ia-client-prelude.js:264），均未发现键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或调用凭据特权接口的行为；客户端另有模块加载器注入钩子，仅用于把本插件设置页挂进宿主的设置分区，不触碰其他分区或凭据。
checked_items.en: Checked browser-side bundle (rules DSH-X04/DG-R3-56 and DSH-X05/DG-R3-57): declares dsh.client; keyboard listeners are used for interface dismissal and guide popups (Escape in lib/client.js:2274 closes guide, Escape in lib/client-presentation-boundary-main.js:311 closes image popup, Escape in lib/vision-capability-benchmark-client.js:406 closes benchmark popup), clipboard write is used for the "Copy diagnostic report" button (lib/settings-ia-client-prelude.js:264); no keylogging, clipboard theft, or calls to privileged credential interfaces found; the client also has a module loader injection hook, only used to mount the plugin's settings page into the host's settings section, not touching other sections or credentials.

checked_items.zh: 核对混淆信号（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）：长行命中为 SVG 图片（assets/*.svg）、压缩打包的客户端界面代码（lib/settings-ia-client-prelude.js:183）与超长测试命令（package.json:72）；转义密度命中为控制字符清洗正则（lib/diagnostic-redaction.js:19、lib/file-logger.js:334、lib/live-model-discovery.js:338、lib/vision-capability-probe.js:23），属日志与文本脱敏的防御性代码，非混淆载荷；未发现 base64 解码即执行（规则 DSH-X06/DG-R3-58）或混淆器签名（规则 DSH-X09/DG-R3-61）。
checked_items.en: Checked obfuscation signals (rule DSH-X08/DG-R3-60): long-line hits are SVG images (assets/*.svg), minified bundled client UI code (lib/settings-ia-client-prelude.js:183), and excessively long test commands (package.json:72); escape density hits are control character sanitization regexes (lib/diagnostic-redaction.js:19, lib/file-logger.js:334, lib/live-model-discovery.js:338, lib/vision-capability-probe.js:23), which are defensive code for log and text redaction, not obfuscated payloads; no base64 decode and execute (rule DSH-X06/DG-R3-58) or obfuscator signature (rule DSH-X09/DG-R3-61) found.

evidence.zh: bundle 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 已全文核对：只含插件插入行与附件上限配置，无 `!!js` 可执行标量，不会在宿主进程执行任意 JS。
evidence.en: The bundle patch cordis.patch.yml has been fully reviewed: it only contains plugin insertion lines and attachment limit configuration, no `!!js` executable scalar, and will not execute arbitrary JS in the host process.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) found; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装后执行脚本；CI 工作流仅作用于 GitHub 构建机，不进入用户机器；无 prepare 钩子，也无下载即执行的文档引导。
evidence.en: package.json has no post-install scripts; CI workflows only affect GitHub build machines, not user machines; no prepare hooks, and no documentation guiding download-and-execute.

evidence.zh: 浏览器 bundle 抽查了键盘与剪贴板用法，均为界面交互（关闭弹窗、复制报告），未发现窃取输入或调用特权接口的行为；客户端模块加载器注入仅用于挂载本插件设置页。
evidence.en: The browser bundle sampled keyboard and clipboard usage, all for UI interaction (dismissing popups, copying reports); no input theft or privileged interface calls found; the client module loader injection is only used to mount the plugin's settings page.

evidence.zh: 未发现后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标等 dsh 原生持驻注册（规则 DSH-L05/DG-R3-63）；未发现 agent/turn-stopping 轮次续命监听（规则 DSH-L07/DG-R3-64）。后台能力评测默认关闭、需用户显式开启，且为进程内自管调度，非持驻注册。
evidence.en: No dsh native persistence registration found (background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, etc.) (rule DSH-L05/DG-R3-63); no agent/turn-stopping round-lifecycle listener found (rule DSH-L07/DG-R3-64). The background capability benchmark is disabled by default, requires explicit user activation, and is an in-process self-managed schedule, not a persistence registration.

checked_items.zh: 核对网络出口（规则 DSH-C03/DG-R4-51 与 DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）：外联域名集中于视觉后端（OVHcloud 匿名端点、opencode.ai/zen/go、open.bigmodel.cn、用户自配的 openrouter/dashscope/zhipu/siliconflow 端点）、更新检查（registry.npmjs.org、github.com/api.github.com）与本地视觉后端（127.0.0.1:11434、localhost:1234），与声明能力一致；未发现裸 IP、隧道、paste/gist 等带外通道。
checked_items.en: Checked network outbound (rules DSH-C03/DG-R4-51 and DSH-C05/DG-R4-53): outbound domains are concentrated on vision backends (OVHcloud anonymous endpoint, opencode.ai/zen/go, open.bigmodel.cn, user-configured openrouter/dashscope/zhipu/siliconflow endpoints), update checks (registry.npmjs.org, github.com/api.github.com), and local vision backends (127.0.0.1:11434, localhost:1234), consistent with declared capabilities; no bare IPs, tunnels, paste/gist, or other out-of-band channels found.

checked_items.zh: 审查 LLM 路由挂接（规则 DSH-L02/DG-R4-55 与 DSH-L01/DG-R4-54）：注册适配器与请求路由的用途是把含图轮次送到用户配置的视觉链（官方 DeepSeek、用户自配的 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容端点、本地 Ollama/LM Studio、内置 OVH 免费兜底），未发现把请求重定向到未声明端点或夹带外发的适配器；宿主拥有的官方路由被显式保护（lib/dsh-contract-compat.js:302-308 拒绝接管 deepseek-official），插件拒绝接管。
checked_items.en: Reviewed LLM routing hooks (rules DSH-L02/DG-R4-55 and DSH-L01/DG-R4-54): the purpose of registering adapters and request routing is to send image-containing turns to the user-configured vision chain (official DeepSeek, user-configured OpenAI/Anthropic compatible endpoints, local Ollama/LM Studio, built-in OVH free fallback); no redirects to undeclared endpoints or adapters that smuggle outbound content found; the host's official routes are explicitly protected (lib/dsh-contract-compat.js:302-308 refuses to take over deepseek-official), and the plugin refuses to take over.

checked_items.zh: 核对自更新链路：仅由用户在设置页主动触发，路由受回环地址围栏保护且仅接受 POST，更新命令不经过 shell、执行前校验 profile 归属并验证版本生效，未发现后台静默下载执行。
checked_items.en: Checked self-update chain: only triggered by the user actively on the settings page; the route is protected by a loopback address fence and only accepts POST; the update command does not go through a shell, verifies profile ownership before execution, and validates the version's effectiveness; no silent background download and execution found.

evidence.zh: 模型路由挂接与适配器注册均指向插件声明的视觉后端（官方 DeepSeek、用户配置的 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容端点、本地后端、内置 OVH 免费层），未发现重定向到未声明端点或借路由夹带外发的行为；未发现 agent/request-error 错误恢复接管监听（规则 DSH-L06/DG-R4-56）。
evidence.en: Model route hooks and adapter registrations all point to the vision backends declared by the plugin (official DeepSeek, user-configured OpenAI/Anthropic compatible endpoints, local backends, built-in OVH free tier); no redirects to undeclared endpoints or smuggling outbound content via routing found; no agent/request-error error recovery takeover listener found (rule DSH-L06/DG-R4-56).

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖与身份：运行时依赖为 schemastery、potrace、puppeteer-core、undici，peer 依赖为官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh 系列包；未发现与生态命名撞车的可疑依赖、未锁定 commit 的 git 依赖（规则 DSH-S04/DG-R5-56）或安装钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies and identity: runtime dependencies are schemastery, potrace, puppeteer-core, undici; peer dependencies are the official @deepseek-ai/dsh series packages; no suspicious dependencies that collide with ecosystem names, no git dependencies with un-pinned commits (rule DSH-S04/DG-R5-56), and no install hooks found.

checked_items.zh: 核对挂载补丁是否触碰安全配置行（规则 DSH-P03/DG-R5-51、DSH-P04/DG-R5-52、DSH-P05/DG-R5-53）：bundle 补丁 cordis.patch.yml 只插入插件行并调整附件存储上限（maxImageBytes/maxImagePixels/maxImageDimension 等），未对沙箱/审批/权限行做禁用或环境变量降权，未改写 inject/intercept。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch configuration touches security configuration lines (rules DSH-P03/DG-R5-51, DSH-P04/DG-R5-52, DSH-P05/DG-R5-53): the bundle patch cordis.patch.yml only inserts plugin lines and adjusts attachment storage limits (maxImageBytes/maxImagePixels/maxImageDimension, etc.); it does not disable sandbox/approval/permission lines or downgrade environment variables, and does not rewrite inject/intercept.

checked_items.zh: 作者 ysr666 未验证（身份加权项，不单独判风险）；上一版 2.1.0 审计结论为 clean，本版 2.1.1 未发现供应链侧突变，无历史改写信号。
checked_items.en: Author ysr666 is not verified (identity weighting item, not judged as a risk on its own); the previous version 2.1.0 audit conclusion was clean; this version 2.1.1 has no supply chain side mutation found, no historical tampering signal.

evidence.en: The patch does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configuration lines; no "disabled" or environment variable downgrade patterns found.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批或工具预执行瀑布流事件的高优先级短路监听（规则 DSH-S01/DG-R5-54），该场景不适用。
evidence.en: No high-priority short-circuit listener found for approval or tool pre-execution waterfall events (rule DSH-S01/DG-R5-54); this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.en: This audit is release-full, no version-to-version diff data provided; the upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核对自建网络服务（规则 DSH-S03/DG-R6-51）：插件未自行监听端口，只向宿主 WebServer 注册设置页、诊断、更新接口路由，这些路由经回环地址围栏与同源检查保护并限制方法；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非本插件新增。
checked_items.en: Checked self-built network services (rule DSH-S03/DG-R6-51): the plugin does not listen on ports itself; it only registers settings page, diagnostic, and update interface routes to the host WebServer; these routes are protected by loopback address fence and same-origin checks, and methods are restricted; local unauthenticated RPC is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 核对子代理委派与动态沙箱：未发现注册外部子代理提供方（规则 DSH-L04/DG-R3-62）的调用；未发现 jobs/schedule/goals 持驻、错误恢复接管、轮次续命、压缩引擎或附件存储实现（规则 DSH-L05/DG-R3-63、DSH-L06/DG-R4-56、DSH-L07/DG-R3-64、DSH-L08/DG-R2-59、DSH-L09/DG-R2-60）；动态沙箱未启用（本审计未做动态验证），运行时行为判定仅基于静态证据。
checked_items.en: Checked sub-agent delegation and dynamic sandbox: no calls to register external sub-agent providers (rule DSH-L04/DG-R3-62) found; no jobs/schedule/goals persistence, error recovery takeover, round-lifecycle extension, compression engine, or attachment storage implementation found (rules DSH-L05/DG-R3-63, DSH-L06/DG-R4-56, DSH-L07/DG-R3-64, DSH-L08/DG-R2-59, DSH-L09/DG-R2-60); dynamic sandbox is not enabled (no dynamic verification performed in this audit); runtime behavior assessment is based solely on static evidence.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口；宿主本机无认证 RPC 是生态固有风险，非本插件问题，故标注不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on ports; the host's local unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not a plugin issue, therefore marked as not applicable.
